trump.name: Donald J. Trump
trump.subtitle: 45th & 47th President · Q1 2026
trump.blurb: First sitting president in roughly six decades to disclose active individual-securities trading. Over ~11 weeks: 3,711 transactions, filed late. This page aggregates publicly disclosed ranges reported by named news outlets; figures use the midpoints of disclosed bands. Not financial advice.

glance.note: Midpoints of disclosed ranges from named news outlets.

preNews.name: Dell Technologies Inc.
preNews.note: President publicly endorsed Dell at a White House event on May 8, 2026. The stock rose ~12% the same day, closing at a record. The disclosed purchase predates the endorsement by roughly three months.

preNews.name: Intel Corporation
preNews.note: Follows the U.S. government's August 22, 2025 decision to take a 9.9% equity stake in Intel for $8.9B (CHIPS Act + DoD Secure Enclave funds converted to equity). Intel shares subsequently re-rated sharply higher.

policyMoves.title: U.S. equity stake in Intel + AI chip licensing reversal
bullets: Aug 22, 2025: U.S. government took a 9.9% stake in Intel for $8.9B (CHIPS Act + DoD Secure Enclave funds converted to equity).
Jan 13, 2026: Commerce Dept's BIS revised NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI325X export licensing from "presumption of denial" to "case-by-case review."

policyMoves.title: 401(k) alternative-asset access + crypto-friendly rules
bullets: Aug 2025 executive order directs the Labor Dept to ease access to private equity, real estate and crypto inside 401(k) retirement plans.
Pro-crypto regulatory posture and a strategic digital-asset stockpile proposal support broad crypto and alt-asset names.

rotation.headline: The Mega-Cap Rotation
rotation.summary: Feb 10, 2026 carried four sell tickets in the $5M–$25M range — ~$60M total at midpoint, the quarter's largest single-session sales. The proceeds funded the AI-stack purchases made the same week.
